verdict.rationale: Cubic supports some bulk-scale operations — codebase scans that deploy many AI agents across an entire repository (cubic-docs-21), CSV export of team analytics data (cubic-docs-19), and PR-level analytics API across all PRs (cubic-docs-20) — but there is no documented feature for a user to explicitly select and act on many individual items (e.g., batch-approve/batch-fix across multiple PRs or findings) in one operation. Missing for 10: explicit multi-PR bulk actions (approve/fix/triage many PRs at once), batch operations UI/API for acting on many findings simultaneously, and independent evidence confirming these bulk workflows work at scale.
